cards.text: Jesus moves on from there and goes along the Sea of Galilee. Then He goes up on a mountain and sits down. And friend, when Jesus sits down, people show up.

cards.question: Large crowds come up that mountain to Jesus. Who do they bring with them?

answers.text: the lame and the blind and the mute

cards.text: They lay them right at His feet, and He heals them. The dead batteries I shared a junk drawer with would've crawled up that mountain on their last little bit of charge.

cards.question: When the crowd sees the mute speaking and the blind seeing, they glorify the God of Israel.

cards.text: Then Jesus calls His disciples over. He tells them He has compassion for this crowd.

cards.question: Jesus says the crowd has already been with Him ___ days and has nothing to eat.
Jesus doesn't want to send the crowd away hungry, because they may faint along the way.

cards.text: The disciples look around. They're in a desolate place with a huge crowd, and there's not a bakery in sight.

cards.question: Out in this desolate place with a huge crowd to feed, what do the disciples ask Jesus?

answers.text: Where could we find enough bread out here
Should we send them all home before dark
How much money do we have left to spend

cards.text: Jesus answers with a question of His own: “How many loaves do you have?”

cards.question: How many loaves do the disciples tell Jesus they have?

cards.text: Seven loaves and a few small fish. Jesus tells the crowd to sit down on the ground, then takes the loaves and the fish.

cards.question: Jesus has the seven loaves and the fish in His hands. What does He do before He breaks them?

cards.text: He breaks them and gives them to the disciples, and the disciples give them to the people. Seven loaves, THAT crowd, and I've done the math four times and it STILL doesn't work.

cards.question: With only seven loaves and a few fish, just some of the people get enough to eat.
When everyone has eaten, the disciples pick up ___ basketfuls of broken pieces left over.

cards.text: Seven basketfuls left over, and Matthew says four thousand men were fed, besides women and children. Seven loaves went in, and seven BASKETS came out.
Then Jesus dismisses the crowds and gets into the boat. Heal them, feed them, send them home, boat. BAM, BAM, BAM, BAM.

cards.question: Jesus gets into the boat and goes to the region of ___.

findings.problem: The passage opens with 'Moving on from there' (Matthew 15:29), which continues from the previous passage. The opening card repeats 'Jesus moves on from there' but never says where 'there' is or what just happened. The baker gets no context for the starting point. Matthew 15:21-28 places Jesus in the region of Tyre and Sidon, where He healed the Canaanite woman's daughter.

rule.text: The opening card can be up to 3 sentences. It says who is speaking, to whom, and what is going on. If the passage starts in the middle of a thought, it gives the context.

findings.problem: This story card has three separate moments: the answer to card 11 extended with the few small fish (15:34), Jesus telling the crowd to sit down on the ground (15:35), and Jesus taking the loaves and the fish (15:36). That is more than two things happening on one card.

rule.text: Aim for one beat per story card. Two is the most. If a story card has more than two things happening, split it.
